notes: PASS means structural parsing completed, indexes stayed within loaded PRJ counts, and the RSC parser consumed the file exactly.
GRP files are size-recorded only; their internal format is not decoded by this tool.
The parser mirrors the original loader's fixed-width little-endian Win32 records and should be checked against a working original executable before changing assets.
The original loader ignores ReadFile success/byte counts; this audit is intentionally stricter and does not modify any input.
